This page lists every option of the config file. Read [Configuration](/guide/configuration) first for the file names and how x18n finds them.

YAML and JSON configs are validated with a JSON Schema. Point your editor at it:

- YAML: `# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://x18n.antfu.dev/schema/config.json` as the first line.
- JSON: `"$schema": "https://x18n.antfu.dev/schema/config.json"`.

`x18n schema config` prints the same schema. A default is the value before presets run. Presets add resources, call specs, derived keys and extraction templates on top of it.

## Options

### `$schema`

Type: `string`

URL of the JSON Schema, for validation in the editor. x18n ignores it.

### `root`

Type: `string`

Default: the directory of the config file

Project root, relative to the config file.

### `name`

Type: `string`

Default: `"default"`

Project name in a monorepo. Default: the directory name.

### `sourceLocale`

Type: `string`

Default: `"en"`

The locale that is the source of truth for checks, prompts and go to definition.

### `locales`

Type: `string[]`

Locale codes as written in paths. Filters the found locales.

### `ignoreLocales`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `[]`

Locale codes to leave out, as written in paths.

### `localeFallbacks`

Type: `'auto' | { [locale: string]: string }`

Default: `{}`

Locale to the locale it falls back to, such as `{ 'en-GB': 'en' }`. A locale with a fallback holds only overrides: a key it lacks or leaves empty is not missing when the fallback chain has it. `'auto'` falls back to the nearest parent language that exists: `en-US` to `en`, `zh-Hant-TW` to `zh-Hant` or `zh`.

### `presets`

Type: `'auto' | PluginSpecifier[]`

Default: `'auto'`

`'auto'` detects built-in presets from the project's dependencies.

### `plugins`

Type: `PluginSpecifier[]`

Default: `[]`

Plugins to add: a package name, a path to a module or to a YAML plugin, or `[specifier, options]`. Paths are relative to the config file.

### `resources`

Type: `ResourceSpec[]`

Default: `[]`

Where the locale files are. Each pattern feeds the `pattern` locale finder. Without patterns, the patterns of all applied presets add up. If they match no file, x18n looks for directories named like `locales`.

Each item of `resources`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern` | `string` | Path pattern with `{locale}`, `{locale?}`, `{namespace}`, `{namespaces}` and `{ext}` tokens and globs. |
| `format`? | `string` | Format id for the matching files, for example `json` or `yaml`. Without it, the file extension picks the format. |
| `namespace`? | `string` | Fixed namespace for every matching file. |
| `locale`? | `string` | Fixed locale for every matching file, for patterns without `{locale}` (`package.nls.json`). |
| `execute`? | `boolean` | Run matching JS/TS files in Node instead of reading them statically. Makes them read-only. |

### `formats`

Type: `{ [extension: string]: string }`

Default: `{}`

Explicit format id per file extension (without dot).

### `keyStyle`

Type: `'auto' | 'nested' | 'flat'`

Default: `"auto"`

Key style of a file that has no keys yet. `flat` writes `"a.b"` keys. `nested` and `auto` write nested objects. A file that already has keys keeps its own style.

### `namespace`

Type: `object`

How keys and namespaces relate in code.

#### `namespace.separator`

Type: `string`

Default: `"."`

Separator between namespace and key in code. `.` merges the namespace into the key path. Default `.`.

#### `namespace.default`

Type: `string`

Namespace of keys written without one.

#### `namespace.fallback`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `[]`

Namespaces searched in order when a key written without a namespace is not in its own (i18next `fallbackNS`).

#### `namespace.byFile`

Type: `{ [glob: string]: string }`

Default: `{}`

Namespace of keys written without one, per glob of source files, before `default`: `{ 'packages/admin/**': 'admin' }`.

#### `namespace.fromPath`

Type: `'dot' | 'slash' | 'camel'`

Default: `"dot"`

How `{namespaces}` folders name a namespace: `dot` makes `pages/home` into `pages.home`, `slash` keeps `pages/home`, `camel` makes `todos-page` into `todosPage`. Default `dot`.

### `usage`

Type: `object`

How x18n finds usages in source files.

#### `usage.include`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `["**/*"]`

Globs of the source files to scan for usages.

#### `usage.exclude`

Type: `string[]`

Default:

  - `**/node_modules/**`
  - `**/.git/**`
  - `**/dist/**`
  - `**/build/**`
  - `**/coverage/**`
  - `**/.nuxt/**`
  - `**/.output/**`
  - `**/.next/**`
  - `**/.svelte-kit/**`
  - `**/*.d.ts`
  - `**/*.min.js`

Globs of the source files to skip. Your list adds to the default list.

#### `usage.calls`

Type: `CallSpec[]`

Default: `[]`

Translate calls to add to the ones of the presets. See [Supported syntax](/plugins/yaml#sections-scanners).

Each item of `usage.calls`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callee` | `string \| string[]` | Function or member path: 't', '$t', 'i18n.t', 'intl.formatMessage'. |
| `kind`? | `'call' \| 'selector' \| 'accessor'` | 'call' (default): the key is an argument. 'selector': the argument is `$ => $.a.b`. 'accessor': member chain on a root. |
| `key`? | `number \| ArgSource` | Which argument holds the key. Default 0. |
| `namespace`? | `ArgSource \| string` | Where the namespace comes from (call option, or factory argument when `factory` is true), or a fixed namespace such as `'shared'` for a hook that wraps `useTranslation('shared')`. |
| `keyPrefix`? | `ArgSource` | Where a key prefix comes from (`keyPrefix` option, or next-intl `useTranslations('a.b')`). |
| `factory`? | `boolean` | The callee is a factory that returns the translate function, for example `useI18n()` returning `{ t }`. |
| `returns`? | `string[]` | For factories: the names of the returned translate functions. Default `['t']`. |
| `types`? | `string[]` | Type names that mark a parameter or prop as a translate function: ['TFunction']. |

An `ArgSource`, as in `key`, `namespace` and `keyPrefix`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `arg` | `number` | Index of the argument, from 0. |
| `property`? | `string` | Property of an object argument that holds the value. |

#### `usage.regex`

Type: `RegexScannerSpec[]`

Default: `[]`

Regex scanners for files that no AST scanner reads, such as PHP or Ruby templates.

Each item of `usage.regex`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `extensions` | `string[]` | File extensions, without dot. |
| `patterns` | `string[]` | Patterns with a `{key}` placeholder (i18n-ally `usageMatchRegex`), or a regex whose first group is the key. |

#### `usage.ignoreCallees`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `[]`

Callee names never counted as translate calls.

#### `usage.keysInUse`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `[]`

Keys (globs) that count as used, for example keys built at runtime.

#### `usage.derivedKeys`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `[]`

Rules like `{key}_plural`: when `{key}` is used the derived keys count as used. Rules apply repeatedly, so with `{key}_*` the key `a_b_c` derives from both `a_b` and `a`. `*` matches one key segment. `{plural}` and `{ordinal}` match a plural or ordinal category (`one`, `few`, `other`): each locale then needs the categories of its own language, and categories the language lacks are optional.

### `write`

Type: `object`

How x18n writes locale files.

#### `write.sort`

Type: `false | 'binary' | 'locale'`

Default: `false`

Key order when x18n writes a file. `binary` sorts by code point, `locale` sorts with a locale-aware compare, `false` keeps the order.

#### `write.indent`

Type: `number | 'tab'`

Indent of written files: a number of spaces, or `tab`. Without it, each file keeps its own indent.

#### `write.keepFilled`

Type: `boolean`

Default: `false`

i18n-ally `keepFulfilled`: `set` in one locale adds the key with an empty value to the others.

### `extract`

Type: `object`

How `x18n extract` finds hard strings and makes keys.

#### `extract.autoDetect`

Type: `boolean`

Report hard strings as `hard-string` diagnostics.

#### `extract.keygen`

Type: `'slug' | 'source' | 'random' | 'empty'`

How `x18n extract` makes a new key: `slug` from the text, `source` uses the text itself, `random`, or `empty`. Default `slug`.

#### `extract.keyCase`

Type: `'camel' | 'snake' | 'kebab' | 'dot'`

Case of slug keys. Default `camel`.

#### `extract.keyPrefix`

Type: `string`

Template with `{fileName}`, `{dirName}` or `{component}`.

#### `extract.keyMaxLength`

Type: `number`

Longest slug, in characters. Default 40.

#### `extract.reuseExisting`

Type: `boolean`

Reuse a key when the same text exists as a source value. Default true.

#### `extract.ignore`

Type: `string[]`

Strings never extracted: an exact string such as `Elk`, or a `/regex/flags` string such as `/^v\d+/i` that matches the text.

#### `extract.ignoreByFile`

Type: `{ [glob: string]: string[] }`

Strings never extracted in the files of a glob, written as in `ignore`.

#### `extract.attributes`

Type: `string[]`

Attribute names whose values are text, on top of those whose last word is `title`, `label`, `text`, `placeholder`, `alt`, `content`, `description`, `message` and the like. Markup attributes outside this set are never extracted.

#### `extract.ignoreAttributes`

Type: `string[]`

Attribute names whose values are never extracted, even text ones such as `alt`.

#### `extract.ignoreCallees`

Type: `string[]`

Accepted by the schema. x18n does not read it yet.

#### `extract.templates`

Type: `(string | ExtractTemplate)[]`

Replacement templates, tried before the templates of presets. See [Extraction templates](/presets#extraction-templates).

Each item of `extract.templates`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | `string` | Replacement code. `{key}` is the key, `{attr}` the attribute name, `{args}` the arguments of a template string. |
| `kinds`? | `string[]` | Hard-string kinds the template applies to, for example `jsx-text`. |
| `files`? | `string[]` | File globs the template applies to. |
| `imports`? | `string[]` | Lines added once per file when missing, for example an import. |

### `checks`

Type: `{ [checkId: string]: CheckSetting }`

Default: `{}`

Overrides on top of the `recommended` check set.

### `strict`

Type: `boolean`

Default: `false`

Turn every warning into an error.

### `ignoreKeys`

Type: `string[]`

Default: `[]`

Keys (globs) excluded from all checks.

### `glossary`

Type: `GlossaryEntry[]`

Default: `[]`

Terms with fixed translations. Translate prompts list them, and the `glossary` check compares values with them.

Each item of `glossary`:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `term` | `string` | The term as written in source values. |
| `translations`? | `{ [locale: string]: string }` | Translation per locale. |
| `note`? | `string` | A note for translators. Translate prompts show it. |
| `doNotTranslate`? | `boolean` | Keep the term as it is in every locale. |

### `history`

Type: `boolean | HistoryOptions`

Default: `true`

History providers for stale translations. `false` turns every provider off. Options of a provider sit under its key, such as `git: { maxDepth, since }` (or `git: false`).

### `review`

Type: `ReviewOptions`

Default: `{"enabled":true,"file":".x18n/reviews.yml"}`

Review comments, approvals and suggested values on messages, kept in a file tracked in git.

### `projects`

Type: `string[]`

Monorepo: directories (globs) that are projects inheriting this config.

## TypeScript only

`defineConfig` in `x18n.config.ts` accepts more than YAML and JSON. These options take plugin objects and functions:

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `presets` | `'auto' \| PresetOption[]` | As in YAML, plus preset objects such as `vueI18n()` from `@x18n/cli/presets`. `false` and `undefined` entries are skipped. |
| `history` | `boolean \| (HistoryOptions & { providers?: HistoryProvider[] \| undefined })` | History providers for stale translations: `false` turns them off; provider options such as `git` sit under their key; `providers` adds providers asked first. |
| `plugins` | `PluginOption[]` | As in YAML, plus plugin and preset objects, for example from `definePlugin`. |
| `checks` | `{ [K in keyof CheckIds]?: CheckSetting } & { [checkId: string]: CheckSetting }` | As in YAML. Plugins add their check ids to the type, so the editor completes them. |
| `pluginConfigs` | `Partial<PluginConfigs>` | Options of plugins, under the key that each plugin declares. |

A `PluginSpecifier` is a string (a built-in preset name, a package name or a path), or `[specifier, options]`. A `CheckSetting` is a severity (`'error'`, `'warning'`, `'info'`, `'hint'` or `'off'`), or `[severity, options]`.
